title: MoCa: Measuring Human-Language Model Alignment on Causal and Moral Judgment Tasks
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on causal and moral judgments in text-based scenarios derived from cognitive science literature.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
